description: pyLCAIO is Maxime Agez's Python tool for hybridising process-based life-cycle inventories with multi-regional input-output data. It combines ecoinvent and EXIOBASE structures to account for upstream contributions missing from a process inventory, including service-sector inputs. Users prepare the supported databases and mappings; the workflow produces hybrid inventories for environmental assessment and Brightway integration. Coverage follows the source databases across regions, industries and reference years, not a fixed facility network. Public source and method documentation are free under GPL-2.0. A limitation is that ecoinvent access has separate commercial terms, and the current workflow requires Brightway2 and compatible database versions. Hybridisation choices can affect truncation corrections and potential double counting, which the linked methodology discusses. The tool can assess environmental consequences of infrastructure material and technology scenarios, complementary to pymrio (model-pymrio). The repository cites several methodological papers, including the Journal of Industrial Ecology article with DOI 10.1111/jiec.12945. No inventory database, commercial content or package dependencies were obtained.
name: pyLCAIO hybrid life-cycle assessment
